rev.t: DHA 6566 is a great place to spend an evening with friends. Loved the ambience, especially the rooftop and open terrace seating. The live music adds a really nice touch, and the 3-floor dining space gives the place a spacious feel. Overall, a nice spot for food, music and a good time. Would definitely visit again!
A very good rooftop resturant. Very nice ambience. The food was really good. The service was excellent. The price is also very reasonable. Highly recommend.
Taste , service as well as ambience was good.
